parameters.query: select employee_id, name, role, raw_data from employees where employee_id = $1

with r as (
  insert into reports (employee_id, draft_json, status)
  values ($1, $2::jsonb, 'pending_approval')
  returning id
)
insert into audit_log (report_id, actor, action, diff)
select id, 'system', 'generated', null from r
returning report_id
